column3: {actor_name:1}, don't go back!\nYou saw those guards.{end_wait}
Some of Dodonpa's men\nran out of the fortress.\nSomething happened there.{end_wait}
Winter's nearly here.\nEven the streets\nfeel colder now.{end_wait}

They say intruders
got inside the fortress.{page_break}Anyone brave enough
to try that must
have been desperate.{end_wait}
Heard what happened\nat the fortress?{end_now}

A group went in
looking for Hammet.{page_break}The guards say
they fled without him.
That's their story.{end_wait}
Whoever went inside\nmust have lost their mind.{page_break}Still... I hope\nthey got away.{end_wait}
Dodonpa's men came back\nbruised and limping.{page_break}They're not so fearsome\nwhen someone fights back.{end_wait}

Donpa himself warned
the guards of intruders.{page_break}I don't know what
to believe about him
anymore.{end_wait}
Someone finally stood up\nto Dodonpa's men.{page_break}For the first time,\nI can breathe a little.{end_wait}
The fortress guards\nhave been doubled.{page_break}Whoever got inside\nmust have frightened them.{end_wait}
The fortress is closed.\nDon't come any nearer.{end_wait}
That man with you...\nI've seen him before.{end_wait}
No. Can't be.\nI must've mistaken him\nfor someone else.{end_wait}
Those warriors from Kalay\ngot past all of us.{page_break}Dodonpa's men blamed\nthe guards at the gate.{end_wait}
That man's face...\nWhy does it look\nso familiar?{end_wait}
Those guards keep running\nback and forth.\nWhat's going on?{end_wait}
The leaves are dying.\nWinter's getting close.\nIt's hard not to notice.{end_wait}
Whoever slipped inside\nis probably trapped.\nI hope they escape.{end_wait}
All those guards,\nand someone still got in.\nHow?{end_wait}
Look at them panic.\nThey don't like feeling\npowerless, do they?{end_wait}
Donpa knows his son's\ndone terrible things.{page_break}But he's still his father.\nCan he really punish him?{end_wait}
They took my sweets.\nI haven't forgotten.\nNot one of them.{end_wait}
One gate, watched all day.\nHow did anyone\nslip past them?{end_wait}
That fellow looks like\nthe merchant we held.{page_break}I only saw him once.\nBetter keep quiet.{end_wait}
We never left our posts.\nI swear no one\npassed through here.{end_wait}
A traveling merchant\ncame to the gate.{page_break}They turned him away.\nNo outsiders allowed.{end_wait}

Our winter trader
was here again.{page_break}The guards sent him off.
Now we can't even
buy what we need.{end_wait}
That poor merchant.\nHe carried his goods\nall this way for nothing.{end_wait}
He's still nearby.\nDoesn't he know\nLunpa is closed?{end_wait}
I saw something shining\nmove toward the fortress.{page_break}It didn't look human.\nWhat was it?{end_wait}
A glowing creature?\nInside the fortress?{page_break}I don't believe it.\nSomeone's making it up.{end_wait}
If a creature got inside,\nmaybe that's why\nthe guards are frightened.{end_wait}
Monsters don't wander\nthrough our streets.{page_break}Not normally, anyway.\nWhat is happening?{end_wait}

Monsters came from
Mt. Aleph's eruption?{page_break}Then the trouble
isn't only here.
That's worse than I{page_break}thought.{end_wait}

Grandfather keeps saying
the eruption means
another great flood.{page_break}He remembers the stories.
I wish he wouldn't.{end_wait}
They say monsters appeared\nbefore the last flood.{page_break}Could it all\nbe happening again?{end_wait}
That flood was ages ago.\nIt can't happen twice.\nCan it?{end_wait}

Trouble is coming.
Take what weapons
you can afford.{page_break}If the roads stay closed,
this stock is all
I'll ever have.{end_wait}
All those weapons,\nand Dodonpa's men\ncouldn't stop a few kids.{end_wait}
I've got good armor.\nMight be the last stock\nto reach Lunpa.{end_wait}
When this is sold,\nI'll close the shutters.\nThere's no more coming.{end_wait}
The armor and weapons\nshops are almost empty.{page_break}We're all running low.\nThis can't go on.{end_wait}
It's not just them.\nI can't get fresh stock\nthrough the gates.{end_wait}
Would you like a room?{end_now}
Go ahead, then.\nI'll have a room ready.\nNo questions asked.{end_wait}
As you wish.\nWe'll have a room\nif you change your mind.{end_wait}
Are you Donpa's guest?{end_now}

Then we've been waiting
for you. Your room
is prepared.{page_break}Donpa asked that you
visit him afterward.{end_wait}
Oh. Then who is\nDonpa expecting?{end_wait}

We were told to air
the guest room and
put out clean sheets.{page_break}In this town?
Who could be coming?{end_wait}

A letter came from
the fortress today.{page_break}Now the boss is cooking
as if we're holding
a festival.{end_wait}

Donpa's sending guests.
Young travelers,
from what I was told.{page_break}I hope they get here.
I prepared the inn.{end_wait}

These must be
Donpa's guests.{page_break}If I'm wrong,
I've made every bed
for nothing.{end_wait}
No one gets through\nthe village gates.{page_break}How are we supposed\nto receive guests?{end_wait}
Donpa looked stronger\nthan I'd expected.\nMaybe the rumors are wrong.{end_wait}
Some of Dodonpa's men\nleft town today.{page_break}Wherever they're going,\nsomeone will suffer for it.{end_wait}

I asked the heavens
to punish those thieves.{page_break}A priest shouldn't
wish harm on anyone.
Yet I meant every word.{end_wait}
The fortress is chaos.\nDon't go near it.{page_break}They're looking\nfor someone to blame.{end_wait}
No merchants enter.\nThose are Dodonpa's orders.{page_break}If you don't belong here,\nget out before he hears.{end_wait}
Are these the intruders?\nNo, they look harmless.{page_break}I don't want to be\nwrong about this.{end_wait}

That merchant wanted
to sell his goods.
I doubt he means trouble.{page_break}Still, I wish he'd leave.
Dodonpa's men have
short tempers.{end_wait}
